caption: The video captures a red disc wedged into a layer of snow capping a horizontal wooden rail, set against a blurred snowy yard and pale house. The camera and rail remain fixed, with the rail's dark knots holding steady in the frame. Throughout the clip the disc drifts slowly to the right along the snow, its left edge leaving a shallow groove that marks the space it has vacated. As it moves, the white snow cap resting on its top thickens while the exposed red rim below shrinks, so the disc appears to settle deeper into the snow. Occasional faint white specks drift in the air above the rail. The rightward slide and gradual burial continue without pause as the disc's right edge nears the rail's right-side knot.
